notes_for_editor: Build year 1937 and destruction year 1962 rest on one page (firelookout.com Henderson Hill); the Forest Fire Lookout Association list confirms only the gone status. A search summary attached the 1962 date to Cameron Peak, but the Henderson Hill page itself gives 1962, so the date stands on that page alone. Cameron Peak is a different Mineral County L-4 tower (1936, destroyed 1962) and the story mentions it to prevent a mix-up. Coordinates in the record come from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list and were not checked in the field. No corrections proposed. No staffing or fire history found.
